newsitem.title: UK: Nationwide to raise mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide to raise mortgage rate.

text.p: Britain's Nationwide Building Society said on Friday it was raising its standard variable mortgage rate by 0.25 percent to 6.99 percent.
The increase will take effect from January 1 1997.
The Nationwide also said it was raising its savings rate by an average of 0.2 percent.
The announcement follows similar moves by other lenders after a 0.25 percent increase in Britain's base lending rate in October and last month's national budget.
Earlier on Friday the Halifax Building Society said it was increasing its mortgage rate to 7.25 percent from 6.99 percent.
The Halifax said it would announce the rise in its saver rate later.
